coupons.title: Discount codes
coupons.subtitle: Codes customers can apply at checkout: percent or flat off, with an optional minimum spend, cap, free shipping, validity window and usage limit.
coupons.emptyMessage: Create a discount code and share it with your customers. They enter it at checkout.
coupons.emptyFilteredMessage: Try another code or state, or clear the filters.
coupons.deleteMessage: Coupon {code} stops working at checkout. Orders that already used it keep their discount.
coupons.codeHint: Letters, numbers, dashes and underscores. Customers type it at checkout.
coupons.maxDiscountHint: The most a percent code can take off. Empty means no cap.
coupons.usageLimitHint: Total redemptions allowed. Empty means unlimited.
coupons.scopeHint: One shop, or every shop of the workspace.
